title: Odoo 18.0 to 19.0 migration investigation
important_note: Every rule/check in this file is mandatory to investigate for the 16→20 migration path. User-reported change descriptions are leads; verify against exact source tags, official docs, edition and owning model before calling a breaking change confirmed or applying a fix.
required_process: Inspect the source-version implementation (18.0) and target-version implementation (19.0) for each finding.
Check official upgrade/migration notes for the transition.
Trace affected references in Python, XML, CSV, manifest, JS, tests and dependencies.
Classify as confirmed incompatibility, likely issue, false positive, or needs investigation.
Propose a minimal fix and describe behavior/security/data risk.
Wait for explicit approval before editing.
transition_focus: API and field removals/renames introduced in this transition

required_checks.title: Compare every common rule against 18.0 and 19.0 source
Review XML view syntax, inherited views and action behavior
Review model fields, method signatures, imports and dependencies
Review frontend modules and asset conventions
Record verified transition-specific changes with citations before adding permanent rules
Mandatory user-identified migration notes for this transition
verification_steps: Inspect every referenced rule even if the simple scanner did not match a token.
For each applicable rule, record applicable/not applicable/false positive/needs investigation and cite exact target source evidence.
Do not apply edits until the user explicitly approves the proposed patch.
